items.title: Her slår «velteren» til: Skal ha gjort dette i to år
items.excerpt: Den maskerte syklisten brydde seg lite om å bli ropt til. Han fortsatte bare å velte.

items.title: Raud Ungdom: Raudt vil halvere støtta til ungdomspartiet

items.title: Ville be for at blinde Thomas skulle få synet tilbake: – Forkvakla form for nestekjærlighet
items.excerpt: Mennene fulgte etter blinde Thomas Tvedt på gata for å helbrede synet hans. Nå håper «The Voice»-artisten at hendelsen vil skape debatt om hvordan synshemmede blir møtt.

items.title: Jane Dodds standing down as Welsh Liberal Democrats leader
items.excerpt: Dodds said it was time to hand over the leadership to a "new generation" after nearly nine years in the role.

items.title: Turkish FA bans 147 officials for breaching betting rules
items.excerpt: Trabzonspor president Ertugrul Dogan is among 147 club officials given a 45-day ban by the Turkish Football Federation (TFF) for breaching betting rules.

items.title: Lebanon faces uncertainty as UNIFIL mandate nears end
items.excerpt: As UN peacekeeping forces prepare to withdraw from Lebanon, Israel remains present and Hezbollah is still armed. A new EU support mission aims to strengthen Lebanon's army, but will not replace UN peacekeepers.

items.title: Sudan drone strike kills around 150 in Abyei market
items.excerpt: A drone strike hit a market in the Abyei border region disputed by Sudan and South Sudan and killed dozens. The drone caused a large fire when it hit a fuel depot. South Sudanese officials blamed Sudan's military.

items.title: Google resolves cloud outage affecting UK banks and websites
items.excerpt: Revolut was one of the hardest hit, with banking services going down for many customers.

items.title: Farage vows to scrap tax on armed forces reserves
items.excerpt: A large group of protesters turned up outside the Reform UK rally in Plymouth with Nigel Farage.
